examples: Original guided calculations and inspected game observations, selected practice exercises; not a verbatim reproduction of every textbook exercise
scope: Full source chapter divided into complementary topic lectures

contract.plane: n·p=d; normalize n and d together; nonzero finite normal. Plane residual is distance only for a unit normal.
contract.normal: Right-handed e1×e2 with both edges at one vertex. Winding and front-face convention explicitly stated.
contract.newell: Ordered closed polygon method; not generic unordered point-cloud least squares. Mean d after normal selection.
contract.barycentric: Sum1; nonnegative inside a nondegenerate triangle; signed subareas; independent coplanarity check; largest-normal-component projection.
contract.attributes: Defined linear RGB/affine surface interpolation, not assumed proprietary implementation; perspective-correct screen interpolation deferred to chapter10.
